personal_statement: I am a Senior ML Engineer and applied AI expert with a Ph.D. from ETH Zurich. I combine software engineering and DevOps with machine learning expertise. I have developed original graph neural network (GNN) and deep generative model applications during my doctoral research. My professional background includes translating cutting-edge research into applied AI solutions. I have deep expertise in benchmarking, building agentic systems, fine-tuning and hyper-parameter optimization for deep learning, and scalable graph feature extraction. Furthermore, I bring consulting experience advising clients on AI/ML solution design, establishing software engineering best practices and processes, and fostering collaborative delivery across technical and business stakeholders.
